name: Fractured Awareness

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-2-spells.

summary: Intelligence save: 12d10 Psychic and Disadvantage on D20 Tests for up to 1 minute with Concentration; success deals half damage without the penalty. Repeat the save at each turn’s end to end the effect.
